Name: Stardew Cartel
Author: atudota
Description:
[center][color=#980000][size=5]Stardew Cartel — New Crops, Chemistry, Custom Effects & Shadow Merchant[/size][/color][/center]
[center][b]A new side of life in Stardew Valley. Grow unusual crops, experiment with fictional in-game crafting, work with custom machines, and meet a mysterious trader with weekly requests.[/b][/center]
Stardew Cartel expands the farming and crafting loop with original pixel-art items, special crops, a dedicated Chemistry Table, an Ore Crusher, consumables with gameplay effects, and an optional NPC named Shade. Build your own production setup, discover recipes, and decide what to grow, process, collect, or sell.
[heading]Features[/heading]
New crops and harvests
Grow six custom crops, each with its own seeds, harvest item, and growth artwork:
[list]
[*]\/ Cannabis \/ [/*]
[*][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/c1kRLCRQ/Cannabisr-Seeds.png[/img][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/N0tTzHcZ/Cannabis.png[/img][/*]
[*]\/ Coca \/ [/*]
[*][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/yxDSZhmv/coca-seed.png[/img][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/Gmws4yHB/coca.png[/img][/*]
[*]\/ Tobacco \/ [/*]
[*][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/50BfkXx1/Tobacco-Seeds.png[/img][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/h40SLQyX/Tobacco.png[/img][/*]
[*]\/ Wild Weed \/ [/*]
[*][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/q7nrzN64/Wild-Weed-seed.png[/img][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/qvN4HbkX/Wild-Weed.png[/img][/*]
[*]\/ Super Blue \/ [/*]
[*][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/J07C6K6b/Super-blue-Seeds.png[/img][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/h4MBzWvG/Super-blue1.png[/img][/*]
[*]\/ Twilight Bloom \/[/*]
[*][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/NFjZ7FFb/dusk-bloom-seeds.png[/img][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/T2tz2VNm/dusk-bloom.png[/img][/*]
[/list]A rare flower associated with the Shade. Crops have their own growth sprites and are registered for all four seasons. Harvested products can be used as crafting materials, sold, or ordered from a merchant.
[center][color=#a2c4c9][size=5]Chemistry Table[/size][/color][/center]
[center]A custom crafting station with its own interface and ingredient slots. Instead of relying only on the vanilla crafting menu, place materials directly into the Chemistry Table and collect the resulting item.
[img width=262]https://i.postimg.cc/3JPxLQTB/chemistry-table.png[/img]
[img width=211]https://i.postimg.cc/Wp5DwyzK/Znimok-ekrana-2026-11-08-112930.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]In-menu recipe book with ingredient requirements[/*]
[*][img width=301]https://i.postimg.cc/HxpxQ0gy/Znimok-ekrana-2026-11-08-112953.png[/img][/*]
[*]Recipe availability and missing-material information[/*]
[*]Quick-fill from your backpack using [b]F[/b] while viewing a recipe in the recipe book[/*]
[*][b]Shift + Left Click[/b] for quick transfers between the backpack and the table[/*]
[*]Ingredient contents are stored with the placed table[/*]
[*]Multiple custom recipes, including crafting supplies, consumables, and fictional products[/*]
[/list][center][size=5][b]Ore Crusher
[img width=110]https://i.postimg.cc/4dtDNqMs/ore-crusher.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]
[center]The Ore Crusher is a separate placeable workstation with large custom artwork. Load a supported in-game material, then interact with the crusher to retrieve its processed result. It has its own crafting recipe and is designed to work alongside the Chemistry Table.[/center]

[center]Stardew Cartel adds medical supplies, crafting materials, and fictional consumables. Depending on the item, use actions may restore
health or energy, apply temporary stat changes, show an animation, or trigger a custom screen effect.
[/center]
[center]The required [b]Stardew Drug Framework[/b] supplies the underlying use-action system, custom item subtypes, temporary gameplay effects, and configurable visuals. The included visual profiles cover:[/center]
[list]
[*]Cokernut[/*]

[*]Benzine[/*]

[*]Cigarette[/*]

[*][img width=48]https://i.postimg.cc/gkcVYRLF/acetone.png[/img][/*]
[/list]Visual presentation varies by item and graphics configuration. Screen effects, world-warp rendering, particle density, and individual profile strengths can be adjusted in the Framework's
[code]config.json[/code][color=#b6b6b6][size=5]Shade — the Shadow Merchant [/size][/color]
[img width=107]https://i.postimg.cc/ZYXmmPMJ/shadow-sprites.png[/img][img width=176]https://i.postimg.cc/SNbPVgPV/Znimok-ekrana-2026-11-08-110324.png[/img]
Install the optional [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55237?published=1][CP] Stardew Cartel - Shadow Merchant[/url][/b] file to add Shade, a mysterious trader found at the [b]Bus Stop[/b].
Shade offers unusual seeds and a separate progression system:
[list]
[*]A custom NPC sprite, portraits, and dialogue[/*]
[*]A dedicated seed shop[/*]
[*]Weekly botanical delivery requests[/*]
[*]Gold rewards and Shade favor for successful deliveries[/*]
[*]Progression connected to rare botanical content and merchant rewards[/*]
[/list][b]Shade controls[/b] (stand near him):
[list]
[*][b]K[/b] — open the shop[/*]
[*][b]J[/b] — view the current order[/*]
[*][b]L[/b] — deliver the requested goods[/*]
[/list]New items and shopping
The mod includes an expanded selection of seeds, harvests, medical supplies, tools, materials, and crafted products, all with custom pixel-art icons. Some supplies are added to existing stores; the optional merchant provides a dedicated location for seeds and related content.
[center][size=5][font=Arial Black][b][color=#ffff00]Localization[/color][/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center]The main Stardew Cartel archive includes localization files for:
[quote][color=#ff7700][b]English[/b], [b]Russian[/b], [b]German[/b], [b]French[/b], [b]Spanish[/b], [b]Italian[/b], [b]Hungarian[/b], [b]Turkish[/b],  [b]Japanese[/b], [b]Korean[/b], [b]Brazilian-Portuguese[/b], [b]Chinese[/b].[/color][/quote](Localization coverage in the Framework and Shadow Merchant packages may differ.)[/center]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[color=#980000][b]!!!!!!Requirements without which the mod will not work!!!!![/b][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=posts&u2PqOG96mP=z1KwuhUc][b]SMAPI [/b][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55234][b]Stardew Drug Framework[/b] [/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55237?published=1][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55237?tab=files][b][CP] Stardew Cartel - Shadow Merchant[/b] [/url][/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55234]Stardew Drug Framework [/url][/b]into your game's
Modsfolder.[/*]
[*]Extract [b]Stardew Cartel[/b] into
[code]Mods[/code][/*]
[*]To add Shade, install Content Patcher and extract [b][CP] Stardew Cartel - Shadow Merchant[/b] into
[code]Mods[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game and check the SMAPI console for missing dependencies or loading errors.[/*]
[/list]Your folder structure should look like this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
  Mods/
    Stardew Drug Framework/
    Stardew Cartel/
    [CP] Stardew Cartel - Shadow Merchant/   [/code][b]Do not install the ZIP files inside one another.[/b] Each mod must be extracted into its own folder.
[heading]Basic controls[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Chemistry Table:[/b] interact with the placed station to open its crafting interface.[/*]
[*][b]Recipe book:[/b] select a recipe to see the required materials; press [b]F[/b] to quick-fill an empty table when possible.[/*]
[*][b]Shift + Left Click:[/b] quickly move items into or out of Chemistry Table slots.[/*]
[*][b]Ore Crusher:[/b] interact while holding a supported material; interact again to retrieve the result.[/*]
[*][b]Shade:[/b] [b]K[/b] for shop, [b]J[/b] for order, [b]L[/b] for delivery when nearby.[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#999999]Configuration and troubleshooting[/color][/heading]
Visual settings can be adjusted in
[code]Mods/Stardew Drug Framework/config.json[/code]. If effects are not visible, first confirm that the Framework loaded correctly and that
[code]EnableScreenEffects[/code]and
[code]EnableWorldWarp[/code]are enabled. Some advanced graphical effects depend on shader compatibility and may not behave identically on every system.
If Shade is missing, make sure Content Patcher and the optional Shadow Merchant pack are installed, then visit the Bus Stop. If an item or crafting station is missing, check the SMAPI console for errors.
